description: Zeck recovery objectives by environment (Deployment & Runtime Architecture D1.0 section 17; WORK-048 / D-07). Repository truth: RTO/RPO are measured claims per environment, never aspirational prose. Targets are validated by deploy:validate and measured by deploy:drill scenarios; provider dashboards, chat or incident notes cannot redefine them.
note: Local/CI targets are measured by the repository drill suites (real PostgreSQL, in-process S3-compatible endpoints). Preview/staging/production targets define the operator contract: the same deploy:drill machinery measures them in those environments with their own credentials — no unexecuted claim exists in this file. The logical-backup procedure's recovery point is the backup creation instant: committed writes after that instant are lost by design and are reported honestly as the measured RPO. The `ha` blocks (WORK-057 / D-08, AVA-002) extend — never replace — the D-07 targets: they declare the primary+standby topology and its failover objectives per environment class, measured by the same machinery through the `authority-failover` drill scenario.

local.scope: Total loss of the local control plane (PostgreSQL authority, artifact-store bytes, queue transport, workflow orchestration, worker region) — disposable synthetic state.
local.measurement: deploy:drill scenario authority-loss + the recovery-drill integration suite over real PostgreSQL 16+: loss instant to every verification gate green.

failover.scope: Authority failover on the local HA topology: a real second local PostgreSQL standby is promoted after primary loss and the D-07 invariant-gate restore proof must pass identically on the promoted authority. The live local authority is only read (safe operator form) — the drill builds a disposable real primary+standby pair.
failover.measurement: deploy:drill scenario authority-failover --environment local + the HA failover integration suite over real PostgreSQL primary + standby: primary-loss instant to every verification gate green on the promoted authority, with the standby's last replayed transaction as the measured RPO anchor.

ci.scope: Same authority-loss scenario exercised by the CI check suite against the real PostgreSQL service (synthetic state).
ci.measurement: The recovery-drill integration suite executed in CI (real PostgreSQL service; no provider credentials).

failover.scope: Authority failover on the CI HA topology: the same disposable primary+standby machinery exercised by the HA integration suite whenever local PostgreSQL server binaries are available to the check runner.
failover.measurement: The HA failover integration suite (real primary + standby PostgreSQL; honest skip when the runner has no server binaries — never a simulated topology).

preview.scope: Loss of a preview deployment's provider resources (per-branch, disposable synthetic state only).
preview.measurement: deploy:drill in the preview environment by the operator; per-branch preview state is synthetic, so the RPO target is zero (nothing authoritative may exist to lose).

failover.scope: Failover of a disposable per-branch preview authority: preview state is synthetic, so the failover path is the re-provision path with the same machinery available for measurement.
failover.measurement: deploy:drill scenario authority-failover --environment preview by the operator against the per-branch topology when one is declared; per-branch preview state is synthetic, so the RPO target is zero.

staging.scope: Loss of staging provider resources (isolated staging database branch, staging artifact bucket, staging queue) with production-like topology.
staging.measurement: deploy:drill in the staging environment by the operator against the isolated staging credentials and resources; measured, recorded, never claimed without execution.

failover.scope: Authority failover on the production-like staging HA topology: promote the staging standby after primary loss; the D-07 invariant-gate restore proof must pass identically on the promoted authority.
failover.measurement: deploy:drill scenario authority-failover --environment staging by the operator against the isolated staging HA endpoints (ZECK_HA_PRIMARY_URL/ZECK_HA_STANDBY_URL): declared-loss instant to every verification gate green, with the standby's last replayed transaction as the measured RPO anchor.

production.scope: Loss of a production provider category (managed PostgreSQL, artifact store, transport/orchestration, hosting region) recovered through the repository-defined procedures; the authoritative PostgreSQL state is restored, never reconstructed.
production.measurement: deploy:drill executed in a controlled production recovery window by the operator with production credentials; the logical-backup cadence bounds the recovery point and every drill records the measured RTO/RPO honestly.

failover.scope: Authority failover on the production HA topology (AVA-002: RTO ≤ 15 minutes): promote the standby after primary loss; the D-07 invariant-gate restore proof must pass identically on the promoted authority; recovery RESTORES authority from replication — it never reconstructs it from providers.
failover.measurement: deploy:drill scenario authority-failover --environment production executed by the operator in a controlled failover window against the production HA endpoints (ZECK_HA_PRIMARY_URL/ZECK_HA_STANDBY_URL): declared-loss instant to every verification gate green, with the standby's last replayed transaction as the measured RPO anchor on the asynchronous path (0 on the synchronous path where configured).
